Analysis.object: The regression analysis revealed that the putative risk factors together are able to explain almost 60% of the variation in disordered eating, and it underlines the need to consider both sport-specific and non-sport-specific factors.

The interpretation is limited, to the type of sports investigated, and not all putative risk factors were considered. Due to the small number of ED cases, no logistic regression analysis to assess the predictive power of putative factors for ED could be performed.

To overcome the limitations, one might need longitudinal risk factor studies and large-scale prevalence studies with single-sport groups, where athletes are approached directly and more putative risk factors are assessed. Special attention should be focused on sports pressure and body dissatisfaction.

Population.object: German female professional athletes. Non athletes required not to have competed at a professional level in any sports before. They were allowed to participate in recreational sports for up to 8h per week.
